## Technical Capabilities & Engineering Stack

### Frontend & Web Architecture
- React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript

### Backend & API Engineering
- Node.js, Express, NestJS, Python (Django, FastAPI), Golang
- REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, microservices architecture, serverless functions

### Mobile Development

### Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure
- Cloud Providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, Vercel
- Containerization & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

### AI Engineering & Intelligent Automation
